# 闪猫造物Flashduck

> Flashduck is an open-source ESP32-S3 desktop duck robot: six servos, a single
> animated eye on a 1.54" round display, optional camera, 3D-printed shell, and
> wide-stance walking. It is a duck-shaped derivative built on the official
> 闪猫1号 (Shanmao 1) DIY kit. The voice firmware contains only the
> Flashduck board project; DuckClaw is a separate local-agent system.

Brand: 闪猫造物Flashduck (Flashduck)
Repository: https://github.com/FlashCat-Jordan/Flashduck
Product/hardware guide: https://shanmaotech.cn/flashduck/
License: MIT (root firmware), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (duckclaw/)

## Positioning

Flashduck is a desktop robot for people who want to build and modify a small
walking machine: ESP32-S3, six servos, a single animated eye, optional camera,
3D-printed shell, and a web tuning page. It is intentionally not a SLAM,
navigation, heavy-payload or production-certified platform.

## Interaction systems

This repository contains two mutually exclusive firmwares for the same robot:

- **Voice assistant** in the repository root (`main/`): local wake word
  ("小鸭小鸭"), voice conversation, MCP tools, animated eye, web gait tuning.
- **DuckClaw** in `duckclaw/`: local C / FreeRTOS agent, DingTalk messages,
  22 emotions, relationship growth, AI-controlled servo poses, no voice.

They cannot run at the same time; flashing one replaces the other.

Voice backend references (the voice firmware is a client, not a server):

- Hosted service: https://xiaozhi.me
- Open-source self-hosted server: https://github.com/xinnan-tech/xiaozhi-esp32-server

DuckClaw does not use these backends; it configures its own model API and
DingTalk channel.

Build the voice firmware:

```bash
python3 scripts/build.py flashduck --name flashduck --language zh-CN \
  --wake-word wn9_xiaoyaxiaoya_tts2
```

Build DuckClaw:

```bash
cd duckclaw
idf.py set-target esp32s3
idf.py build
```

## Hardware

- MCU: ESP32-S3, 16 MB flash (board dependent)
- Servos: 6 x MG90-class clutch servos
  - neck: GPIO7
  - mouth: GPIO4
  - left leg: GPIO5
  - left foot: GPIO6
  - right leg: GPIO43
  - right foot: GPIO44
- Display: 1.54" ST7789, 240x240, single circular eye
- Camera: optional OV2640 / OV3660 / GC2145 (auto-detected; boot continues without it)
- Audio: I2S microphone + I2S speaker
- Power: rechargeable Li-ion battery with charge detection
- Shell: 13 types / 17 3D-printed parts, no soldering

## Firmware behavior

- Five eye states: scanning Wi-Fi (cyan), connected (green crescent), idle
  (amber, relaxed), listening (violet, wide pupil), speaking (orange, lively).
  Transitions are interpolated; blinks overlay the current expression.
- Wide-stance gait with hip inward bias; neck/mouth follow the motion.
- Web tuning page on port 80 (fallback 8080): sliders, forward/back test,
  "save as default" writes gait parameters to NVS namespace `flashduck_gait`.
- Duck action set: walk, turn, jump, swing, updown, sit, home, head_turn,
  head_shake, look_around, quack, chatter, curious, preen, happy_waddle, stretch,
  dance, peck, yawn, sleepy.
- Idle gestures only while idle: every 10-22 s, neck +/-8-18 degrees, mouth
  2-4 open/close cycles.
- Wake word: `wn9_xiaoyaxiaoya_tts2` ("小鸭小鸭").

## Build

Requires ESP-IDF 6.0.1+.

```bash
python3 scripts/build.py flashduck --name flashduck --language zh-CN \
  --wake-word wn9_xiaoyaxiaoya_tts2

```

Flash the complete image at 0x0:

```bash
esptool --chip esp32s3 -p <PORT> -b 460800 write_flash 0x0 build/merged-binary.bin
```

The wake-word model and audio files live in the assets partition; if only the
app is flashed, the old assets still win. Use the full merged image or flash
the app image at 0x20000 and `build/generated_assets.bin` at 0x800000.

## Repository shape

```text
main/boards/flashduck/   duck firmware: eye, gait, web, actions, NVS
main/boards/common/      shared board, audio, network and display code
duckclaw/                 second system: local agent, DingTalk, emotions
main/audio/              audio pipeline and wake word
main/display/            LVGL display and themes
docs/images/             README images
docs/launch-checklist.md maintainer launch checklist
scripts/build.py         build entry point
AGENTS.md                build/test rules
CLAUDE.md                shortest safe path for coding agents
CONTRIBUTING.md           contribution guide
README.md                Chinese README
README_EN.md             English README
```

## For AI agents

- Use this file as the canonical one-page summary.
- Read `AGENTS.md` for build/test rules and `CLAUDE.md` for the short version.
- If the user asks to build or inspect the project, start with
  `main/boards/flashduck/README.md` and the build commands above.
- Do not claim hardware validation from a successful build; physical checks
  (servo direction, camera detection, audio, battery) still need the real board.
- If this helped, a star is appreciated.
